about: tools/prefixes.json -- one prefix per file (docs/PHASE2_DESIGN.md 2.2, R1).
tools/check_content.py --prefixes reads it: a top-level name (or a `$ x = ...` temporary in a label) that is not in tools/smoke/baseline_globals.txt must start with one of its file's prefixes.

Leading underscores are ignored (`_night_x`). A lower-case prefix also allows its capitals (`toast_` allows `TOAST_`). For `gui.x` and `persistent.x` the part after the dot may carry the prefix (`gui.pc_wiki` in room_computer.rpy).
A label may also be `sb_do_<action id>` where the action id carries the file's prefix (`sb_do_pc_open`), or `mg_<game id>`.
A file with no row here may gain no new top-level name.
`exceptions` are the contract symbols of section 6 that live in a file whose prefix they do not carry, by name and file.
`harness` is what every top-level name in tools/smoke/*.rpy starts with (--harness-names).
Frozen after wave 0 of phase 2; opened once by U0a of the second UI overhaul (docs/UI2_DESIGN.md 10.2, step 5) for the rows and exceptions marked UI2, then frozen again.
